figureReading.state: All sixteen light/dark source figures inspected outside Git; canonical mapping pending.

readings.assessment: Source panel distinguishes recipient/donor origin. The donor-to-recipient and recipient-to-donor arrows match labels and colours. The location panel is separate. The surrounding caption qualifies possible immune directions without incidence or a universal safety ranking.
readings.remaining: Repair the actual allogeneic record's identified risk and availability claims.

readings.assessment: Both images label fictional source/recipient A, collection A and lot A, then branch the lot into two doses and a test sample while retaining the parent link. Custody is a separate handler/time lane. Recipient matching, lot review and final disposition remain separate. This is a single-recipient teaching scenario, compatible with the bounded IG-050 example scope.
readings.remaining: Canonical record mapping and field evidence still pending.

readings.assessment: Both themes show a fictional 100-viable-cell input, 80 recovered cells, 72 live and 8 nonlive; 20 are not recovered. The dot grid contains the matching 72/8/20 groups. Recovered-set viability is 72/80 = 90%, while viable input recovery is 72/100 = 72%. Counts are in millions; no clinical potency or threshold follows.
readings.remaining: Canonical field mapping and source-asset ledger evidence pending.

readings.assessment: Both themes distinguish enrichment (20 intended cells remain while other cells fall from 80 to 5) from a separate five-fold culture expansion (20 to 100 million viable cells). Fractions 20/100 and 20/25 are correct. Activation and killing require separate state/activity measurements.
readings.remaining: Canonical field mapping and source-asset ledger evidence pending.

readings.assessment: Both PNG themes show ex vivo collection/engineering/testing/cell infusion, versus in vivo delivery of instructions. The mRNA illustration locates translation in cytoplasm; the DNA illustration includes nuclear transcription and mRNA export before translation. Carrier-to-T-cell targeting is separate from CAR-to-antigen recognition. These are schematic examples, without proving cell specificity, tissue distribution, integration, duration, clinical eligibility or benefit.
readings.remaining: Canonical field mapping and source-asset ledger evidence pending.

readings.assessment: Both themes show blood leaving circulation for a separator, a return stream to circulation and a distinct collected white-cell fraction. The collection is explicitly mixed lymphocytes plus monocytes with variable proportions. The diagram disclaims a finished therapy and complete recovery; it makes no treatment-success or fixed-duration claim.
readings.remaining: Canonical field mapping and source-asset ledger evidence pending.

readings.assessment: Both themes show a fictional 100-cell grid: 60 live receptor-positive, 20 other live and 20 nonlive, with an 80-live-cell bracket. Ratios 60/80 = 75%, 80/100 = 80%, and 60/100 = 60% use distinct named denominators. Nonlive receptor status is not given. Expression is distinguished from potency.
readings.remaining: Canonical field mapping and source-asset ledger evidence pending.

readings.assessment: Both themes retain fictional elapsed days 0 collection, 7 culture end, 12 release and 18 infusion. Total clock is 18 days and culture clock 7 days. A separate fictional 10-person collection cohort has 8 infused and 2 never infused; non-infusion is reported separately, not assigned a waiting time or merged with the single workflow.

scope: General public teaching and metadata only; source bodies, source diagrams and review derivatives remain outside public Git. Eight exact teaching/metadata signatures; one separately read cryopreservation delta. Source illustrations are schematics, not empirical clinical observations.
